description: Gzip byte budgets for production JS chunks (see scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs).
threeChunkComment: WebGL + WebGPU three currently land in ONE `three` chunk (the manualChunks rule in vite.config.js does not split them), so the `three` budget covers what used to be `three` (195000) + `three.webgpu` (180000), with a little headroom. Splitting them again — so ?webgl never downloads the WebGPU build — is tracked in the bundle-payload issue; when that lands, restore the two separate budgets.
demandLoadedComment: Chunks fetched only by a subset of sessions, so they do not belong in the every-session (eager) total. Each still needs its own `chunks` budget or an explicit note below.

demandLoaded.reason: LTC BRDF tables; WebGPU at the high quality profile only (AccentLightRig.js)
